name: seat-month
about: What a team pays per month for storage work, by kind of seat (usage/profiles.json) and team size, on each provider, using the storage design that won storage-sim (record store exact order + daily search segments). The seat price is not included. Ranges cover the fault profiles none, light and heavy at seed 42. Seed 7 was also run for 213 of the runs (every run up to about 90,000 requests): weighted by dollars it moved them by 0.37% in total (median run 0.5%), below the median fault spread of 0.8%; only rare events of under one a day moved more (one versus two occurrences in 10 days, fractions of a cent).

horizon.basis: 10 simulated days per run, fewer when a run would exceed 300,000 requests (the runner's throughput is 10 to 900 requests per second on this design), never fewer than 2 so storage growth per day is measured. Usage is scaled to 30 days. The design is built to cost the same per operation on day 1 and day 365 (plan 03 C22); each run's growth ratios are in its saved result.

team.basis: Each person's records, commands and files live in that person's own stores, so per-seat work is simulated once and multiplied by the seats.

workloads.basis: Assumed: a team keeps what it shares in one team space, so every seat's shares land on the same store.
Assumed: teammates read shared records from the one team space; its load and queueing grow with the team.
